name: Zero Ordering Width Characterization
statement: $\sigma(C)=0$ if and only if $C$ is dismantlable ample, equivalently its concepts admit an order in which every nonempty prefix is ample.
proof: Minimal predecessor disagreements are the supports of minimal colon generators of the Alexander-dual Yang ideal. Width zero is therefore linear quotients. Alexander duality identifies this with shellability, and the established shelling dictionary identifies the relevant shelling orders with ample-prefix orders.
